notice: Lifecycle states, layers and promotion criteria for Evidence Atlas expansion records. A record's presence in the Public Data Catalog never implies it is evidence.

layers.description: Broad metadata discovery. Records need not be scientifically comparable.
Records that satisfy every hard eligibility criterion, plus those undergoing or having completed validation but not yet frozen into a release.
Validated records frozen into an immutable, versioned release manifest. Membership is defined by the release manifest, not by a mutable flag.

states.meaning: Discovered and metadata snapshot stored. No scientific claim.
Queued for (re-)evaluation against the eligibility criteria.
Every hard criterion PASS under the stated policy version.
At least one hard criterion FAIL. Retained in the catalog with reasons.
Abstention: at least one hard criterion UNKNOWN or a normalization conflict. Requires curation; never auto-promoted.
Selected for processing under a frozen protocol; validation not yet complete.
Passed the frozen validation gates of its protocol; release-ready but not yet released.
Failed at least one validation gate. Retained with the validation report.
Included in at least one immutable release manifest.
Source suppressed/withdrawn or terms changed; excluded from future releases. Past releases are not altered.

transition_rules: No transition into ELIGIBLE may rely on an ML-only hard-gate value; E13 is UNKNOWN for such records, so evaluation yields NEEDS_REVIEW.
NEEDS_REVIEW -> ELIGIBLE and NEEDS_REVIEW -> INELIGIBLE require a recorded human curation decision.
INELIGIBLE -> ELIGIBILITY_PENDING is allowed only when the source metadata snapshot or the policy version changes.
VALIDATED -> RELEASED happens only by inclusion in a release manifest; the release manifest is the authority.
RELEASED -> WITHDRAWN excludes the record from future releases; it never edits a past release.
Any change to a released record's scientific content creates a new record version; the released version is immutable.

aggregation.note: FAIL dominates UNKNOWN: a record with a definite disqualifier is INELIGIBLE even if other criteria are unknown. NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed only for criteria marked applicability: CONDITIONAL.

criteria.name: stable_public_accession
criteria.requirement: Record has a stable public accession (INSDC run/sample/study accession or an authoritative resource persistent identifier) that is not suppressed.

criteria.name: organism_resolved
criteria.requirement: Organism resolved to an NCBI Taxonomy ID at species rank or below from authoritative metadata, a deterministic rule, or curation.

criteria.name: open_access
criteria.requirement: Data are open access; controlled-access records (e.g. dbGaP, EGA) are INELIGIBLE.

criteria.name: platform_resolved
criteria.requirement: technology_family and vendor resolved; instrument_family resolved or explicitly UNSPECIFIED without conflict.

criteria.name: library_in_domain
criteria.requirement: Library strategy and source fall inside the target evidence domain (e.g. WGS/GENOMIC for germline small variants).

criteria.name: assembly_resolved
criteria.requirement: Reference assembly known by accession.version, or a defensible mapping path to a registered assembly exists.

criteria.name: provenance_usable
criteria.requirement: Source query, retrieval timestamp and raw metadata snapshot SHA-256 recorded.

criteria.name: public_data_available
criteria.requirement: At least one publicly retrievable data or derived-output artifact with size and checksum (or publisher checksum).

criteria.name: truth_or_comparator_relationship
criteria.requirement: Where the evidence domain requires it, a versioned truth/benchmark/comparator resource exists for this sample and assembly.

criteria.name: source_terms_compatible
criteria.requirement: Source terms recorded, snapshotted and compatible with the intended derived use and redistribution.

criteria.name: reproducible_transformation_path
criteria.requirement: A frozen protocol exists for this evidence domain and technology family.

criteria.name: deduplicated
criteria.requirement: Record is the canonical member of its duplicate cluster; mirrors are not separate candidates.

criteria.name: hard_gate_fields_authoritatively_backed
criteria.requirement: Every hard-gate field is backed by authoritative source metadata (SOURCE_CONTROLLED), deterministic normalization of authoritative metadata (RULE_EXACT, RULE_PATTERN), or explicit curator confirmation (CURATED), with no unresolved conflict. An ML-only value never satisfies this criterion, whatever its confidence: it yields UNKNOWN, so the record goes to NEEDS_REVIEW.

ml_hard_gate_rule: An ML_PROPOSED value is never sufficient for a hard-gate field. Before any record enters ELIGIBLE, each hard-gate field must use a method in hard_gate_accepted_methods. ML may propose values, assign confidence and route records to NEEDS_REVIEW; a curator who confirms a proposal records it as CURATED.
